Current Omgevingsplan confirmed. Dedicated municipal information already confirms splitting requires an omgevingsvergunning. A current municipality-specific policy 'Woningsplitsing en kamergewijze verhuur' is officially published and remains in force. It explicitly regulates both woningsplitsing and kamergewijze verhuur, including use of an omgevingsvergunning to deviate from the plan. This materially closes the earlier substantive legal residual.

Current Omgevingsplan confirmed. In addition, current 2026 Beleidsregel Woningsplitsing confirms the substantive splitting framework, with maximum four dwellings, minimum area rules, parking/neighbour participation and extra monument requirements including possible bouwhistorisch onderzoek. The former splitting residual is fully closed; ordinary room-rental/opkoopbescherming remains separate.

Major closure. Current Omgevingsplan contains an explicit binnenplanse vergunning rule for woningsplitsing with substantive criteria (one extra dwelling, volume/heritage/liveability/landscape conditions and current woonvisie linkage). This current primary law supersedes the old generic uncertainty on woningsplitsing.
